title_original: 세수추계위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 4 (Duties of the Chairperson, etc.)
(1) The chairperson shall represent the Committee and exercise overall control over its affairs.
(2) Where the chairperson is unable to perform his or her duties for unavoidable reasons, the vice-chairperson shall act on the chairperson's behalf; where both the chairperson and vice-chairperson are unable to perform their duties for unavoidable reasons, a Committee member designated in advance by the chairperson shall act on the chairperson's behalf.
